cohort: The study analyzed aggregated data on live births in Brazil and health facilities from the Brazilian Information System on Live Births and the 2017 National Registry of Health Facilities.
finding: Brazil exhibited high overall (55.1%) and repeated (85.3%) cesarean section rates, with private hospitals consistently showing the highest rates across all gestational ages.
mod_finding: Overall cesarean section rates in Brazil were 55.1% and repeated cesarean section rates were 85.3%, with over 60% of newborns at 37-38 weeks delivered via cesarean section.
gest_age: Gestational age at birth was categorized into subgroups: <= 33 weeks, 34-36 weeks, 37-38 weeks, 39-41 weeks, and >= 42 weeks.
